title: Scripture, Tradition and the Church
tagline: Sola scriptura or Scripture, Tradition and Magisterium together? And how Catholics read the Bible.
whyItMatters: Almost every disagreement with Protestant friends rests on who has authority to say what Scripture means. Knowing the Catholic answer, and the Protestant one, makes every other talk clearer.

mindset.tip: Start by finding what your friend means by “Scripture alone”; people mean very different things.
Honour what we share: the Bible is God’s Word, and many Protestants love and know it deeply. (CCC 819, 838)
Read the other side in its own words.
Argue from the Bible and the early Church, not only from authority. (2 Thessalonians 2:15)
